description:
MacPilot Remote is the iPhone remote for MacPilot. When your iPhone and Mac are on the same Wi-Fi they connect directly, so you can lock, blank, unlock or wake & unlock your Mac in one tap. When the network is out of reach, a Bluetooth fallback link keeps you in control.

Highlights
• One-tap Lock / Blank / Unlock / Wake & Unlock
• Direct local-network connection — no servers in between
• Bluetooth fallback link when Wi-Fi is out of reach
• Manage multiple Macs and pick a default
• Pair with a 6-digit code; all traffic is encrypted after pairing
• Connection diagnostics: discovery, handshake and round-trip latency

Requirements
You need MacPilot installed on your Mac with iPhone remote control enabled in its Remote Control settings:
https://github.com/misswell/MacPilot

Privacy
Everything happens device-to-device on your own network. No servers, no data collection. Your Mac login password never leaves the Mac.
whatsNew:
• New: Remote Trackpad pressure simulation — light taps, firm presses and press-to-drag now feel like a MacBook trackpad
• Native iPad support with adaptive layout
• Trackpad edge arrows switch the hold; landscape holds open the keyboard sideways
• A single tap on a text field opens the remote keyboard
